lag.description: Half-hour steps for the water to close its gap to the air: each step it goes 1/lag of the way.

minWater.description: The coldest the water gets, on the weather's temperature scale: it never freezes.

trendLag.description: Half-hour steps for the water's slow average to close its gap to the water. Warmer than that average, the water is warming (D153).

gather.description: A spawning fish's weight in its spot's tables is multiplied by this.

schools.description: A spawning fish's school is this many times likelier to come up on the water.
